read.name: file.read
read.description: Read the contents of a file within the project

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the file

write.name: file.write
write.description: Write UTF-8 content to a file (creates parent directories). Whitespace is preserved exactly as supplied. JSON newline escapes must decode to actual newline characters; literal backslash sequences are not decoded again.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the file

content.description: Exact file content, including required trailing newlines and CRLF. Copy the raw read content, not line-numbered display text.

list.name: file.list
list.description: List files and directories at a path within the project

stat.name: file.stat
stat.description: Get file metadata (size, type, modified date)

image.name: image.view
image.description: Display a project image in the tool card. The user already sees the image there; do not repeat it in assistant messages with Markdown image embeds, attachments, or redundant file links unless explicitly requested. Do not call after screenshot.capture or browser.screenshot: those tools already display the image. Do not call again when a tool card has already shown the image.
